name: How can I prevent bathtub drain clogs in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent bathtub drain clogs in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future bathtub drain clogs, regularly use a drain screen or hair catcher to prevent hair and debris from entering the drain. Periodically flush the drain with hot water after use to help dissolve soap scum. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemicals down the drain. For homes in areas with hard water, like parts of Las Vegas, mineral buildup can contribute to clogs, so a water softener could be a long-term preventative measure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using a drain screen, flushing with hot water, avoiding grease, and considering a water softener in hard water areas.
